title: Dream of the Red Chamber
synopsis: "Dream of the Red Chamber" is an 18th-century Chinese masterpiece by Cao Xueqin that portrays the rise and fall of four aristocratic families while offering a profound reflection on love, fate, and the impermanence of life.

fullText.simplified:
中国古典文学的巅峰之作——《红楼梦》

    曾经有人用这样一句话来表达一见钟情的美好：“所有的相遇都是久别重逢。”意思是很多看起来第一次见的人，其实在前世就已经有了很深的关系。在古典小说《红楼梦》中，贾宝玉第一次见到林黛玉时，也说过一句意思相近的话：“这个妹妹我曾见过的。”
    《红楼梦》是中国最著名的古典小说之一，写于清代中期。这部小说以贾、史、王、薛四大家族从兴盛到败落的变化为背景，以贾宝玉与林黛玉的爱情悲剧为主线，描写了古代中国上层社会的生活情景，体现了真实的人性与时代悲剧。
    《红楼梦》的作者是曹雪芹。他出生在一个高官家庭，少年时过着富贵的生活。中年时家道败落，生活困难。晚年生活更加艰苦，经常缺衣少食，不到50岁就去世了。因此，许多人都认为从这部小说里可以看到曹雪芹自己的人生经历。
    《红楼梦》最早的名字叫《石头记》。故事从天界一块被人遗忘的石头开始。这块石头想来人间看看，刚好有位神仙也想来人间体验生活，于是他们就一起来到了人间。这位神仙叫神瑛侍者，转世成为了贾家的一员——贾宝玉。那块石头则变成了贾宝玉出生时含在嘴里的一块宝玉。贾宝玉长相帅气，性格却很特别，他讨厌成年男性的虚伪，认为温柔的女子更加单纯美好。因此，他喜欢与家中的姐姐妹妹们一起玩。一天，一位名叫林黛玉的漂亮妹妹来到贾家。贾宝玉见到她的第一眼，就忍不住说道：“这个妹妹我曾见过的。”他为什么会觉得林黛玉很熟悉呢？也许是因为他们前世见过面。林黛玉前世是天界的一棵仙草，神瑛侍者经常给她浇水，使她得到了灵气。后来她转世为人，来人间还神瑛侍者的浇水之恩。
    《红楼梦》写成后的很长一段时间里，只有前80回被人传阅，大家都不知道完整的结局是什么。现在大家看到的《红楼梦》有120回，一般认为前80回是曹雪芹写的，后40回是另一位叫高鹗的作家整理和续写的。由于小说的前后部分可能不是同一个人完成，所以故事的“真正结局”一直是个有趣的话题。
    不同的人看《红楼梦》会有不同的感受：有人看到浪漫的爱情，有人看到无常的人生，还有人看到了古代中国的文化细节。可以说，如果想要欣赏最经典的中文文学，《红楼梦》是一定要读的书。如果觉得读原著太难，可以选择观看1987年版的电视剧《红楼梦》。很多人都认为它是最接近原著、最能帮助读者轻松了解原著的电视剧。如果你对《红楼梦》感兴趣，可以先去看看这部电视剧。
fullText.traditional:
中國古典文學的巔峰之作——《紅樓夢》

    曾經有人用這樣一句話來表達一見鐘情的美好：“所有的相遇都是久別重逢。”意思是很多看起來第一次見的人，其實在前世就已經有了很深的關係。在古典小說《紅樓夢》中，賈寶玉第一次見到林黛玉時，也說過一句意思相近的話：“這個妹妹我曾見過的。”
    《紅樓夢》是中國最著名的古典小說之一，寫於清代中期。這部小說以賈、史、王、薛四大家族從興盛到敗落的變化為背景，以賈寶玉與林黛玉的愛情悲劇為主線，描寫了古代中國上層社會的生活情景，體現了真實的人性與時代悲劇。
    《紅樓夢》的作者是曹雪芹。他出生在一個高官家庭，少年時過著富貴的生活。中年時家道敗落，生活困難。晚年生活更加艱苦，經常缺衣少食，不到50歲就去世了。因此，許多人都認為從這部小說裡可以看到曹雪芹自己的人生經歷。
    《紅樓夢》最早的名字叫《石頭記》。故事從天界一塊被人遺忘的石頭開始。這塊石頭想來人間看看，剛好有位神仙也想來人間體驗生活，於是他們就一起來到了人間。這位神仙叫神瑛侍者，轉世成為了賈家的一員——賈寶玉。那塊石頭則變成了賈寶玉出生時含在嘴裡的一塊寶玉。賈寶玉長相帥氣，性格卻很特別，他討厭成年男性的虛偽，認為溫柔的女子更加單純美好。因此，他喜歡與家中的姐姐妹妹們一起玩。一天，一位名叫林黛玉的漂亮妹妹來到賈家。賈寶玉見到她的第一眼，就忍不住說道：“這個妹妹我曾見過的。”他為什麼會覺得林黛玉很熟悉呢？也許是因為他們前世見過面。林黛玉前世是天界的一棵仙草，神瑛侍者經常給她澆水，使她得到了靈氣。後來她轉世為人，來人間還神瑛侍者的澆水之恩。
    《紅樓夢》寫成後的很長一段時間裡，只有前80回被人傳閱，大家都不知道完整的結局是什麼。現在大家看到的《紅樓夢》有120回，一般認為前80回是曹雪芹寫的，後40回是另一位叫高鶚的作家整理和續寫的。由於小說的前後部分可能不是同一個人完成，所以故事的“真正結局”一直是個有趣的話題。
    不同的人看《紅樓夢》會有不同的感受：有人看到浪漫的愛情，有人看到無常的人生，還有人看到了古代中國的文化細節。可以說，如果想要欣賞最經典的中文文學，《紅樓夢》是一定要讀的書。如果覺得讀原著太難，可以選擇觀看1987年版的電視劇《紅樓夢》。很多人都認為它是最接近原著、最能幫助讀者輕鬆了解原著的電視劇。如果你對《紅樓夢》感興趣，可以先去看看這部電視劇。

sentences.simplified: 一般认为前80回是曹雪芹写的，
sentences.traditional: 一般認為前80回是曹雪芹寫的，
sentences.pinyin: yì bān rèn wéi qián 2 huí shì cáo xuě qín xiě de
sentences.english: It is generally believed that the first eighty chapters were written by Cao Xueqin, ..

sentences.simplified: 后40回是另一位叫高鹗的作家整理和续写的。
sentences.traditional: 後40回是另一位叫高鶚的作家整理和續寫的。
sentences.pinyin: hòu 2 huí shì lìng yí wèi jiào gāo è de zuò jiā zhěng lǐ hé xù xiě de
sentences.english: .. and the latter forty chapters were compiled and continued by another writer named Gao E.

sentences.simplified: 由于小说的前后部分可能不是同一个人完成，
sentences.traditional: 由於小說的前後部分可能不是同一個人完成，
sentences.pinyin: yóu yú xiǎo shuō de qián hòu bù fen kě néng bú shì tóng yī ge rén wán chéng
sentences.english: Since the beginning and ending parts of the novel may not have been completed by the same person, ..

sentences.simplified: 所以故事的“真正结局”一直是个有趣的话题。
sentences.traditional: 所以故事的“真正結局”一直是個有趣的話題。
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ gù shi de zhēn zhèng jié jú yì zhí shì ge yǒu qù de huà tí
sentences.english: .. the “true ending” of the story has long been an intriguing topic of discussion.

sentences.simplified: 不同的人看《红楼梦》会有不同的感受：
sentences.traditional: 不同的人看《紅樓夢》會有不同的感受：
sentences.pinyin: bù tóng de rén kàn hóng lóu mèng huì yǒu bù tóng de gǎn shòu
sentences.english: Different people have different feelings when reading “Dream of the Red Chamber”.

sentences.simplified: 有人看到浪漫的爱情，有人看到无常的人生，还有人看到了古代中国的文化细节。
sentences.traditional: 有人看到浪漫的愛情，有人看到無常的人生，還有人看到了古代中國的文化細節。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu rén kàn dào làng màn de ài qíng yǒu rén kàn dào wú cháng de rén shēng hái yǒu rén kàn dào le gǔ dài zhōng guó de wén huà xì jié
sentences.english: Some see romantic love, some see the impermanence of life, and others see the cultural details of ancient China.

sentences.simplified: 可以说，如果想要欣赏最经典的中文文学，
sentences.traditional: 可以說，如果想要欣賞最經典的中文文學，
sentences.pinyin: kě yǐ shuō rú guǒ xiǎng yào xīn shǎng zuì jīng diǎn de zhōng wén wén xué
sentences.english: It can be said that if one wishes to appreciate the most classic works of Chinese literature, ..

sentences.simplified: 《红楼梦》是一定要读的书。
sentences.traditional: 《紅樓夢》是一定要讀的書。
sentences.pinyin: hóng lóu mèng shì yí dìng yào dú de shū
sentences.english: .. “Dream of the Red Chamber” is an essential read.

sentences.simplified: 如果觉得读原著太难，可以选择观看1987年版的电视剧《红楼梦》。
sentences.traditional: 如果覺得讀原著太難，可以選擇觀看1987年版的電視劇《紅樓夢》。
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ jué de dú yuán zhù tài nán kě yǐ xuǎn zé guān kàn 4 nián bǎn de diàn shì jù hóng lóu mèng
sentences.english: If you find reading the original work too difficult, you can choose to watch the 1987 television series “Dream of the Red Chamber”.

sentences.simplified: 很多人都认为它是最接近原著、最能帮助读者轻松了解原著的电视剧。
sentences.traditional: 很多人都認為它是最接近原著、最能幫助讀者輕鬆了解原著的電視劇。
sentences.pinyin: hěn duō rén dōu rèn wéi tā shì zuì jiē jìn yuán zhù zuì néng bāng zhù dú zhě qīng sōng liǎo jiě yuán zhù de diàn shì jù
sentences.english: Many consider it the television adaptation that stays closest to the original novel and best helps viewers understand it with ease.

sentences.simplified: 如果你对《红楼梦》感兴趣，可以先去看看这部电视剧。
sentences.traditional: 如果你對《紅樓夢》感興趣，可以先去看看這部電視劇。
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ nǐ duì hóng lóu mèng gǎn xìng qù kě yǐ xiān qù kàn kan zhè bù diàn shì jù
sentences.english: If you are interested in “Dream of the Red Chamber”, you can start by watching this television series.

sentence_translations: The Pinnacle of Chinese Classical Literature: “Dream of the Red Chamber”
Someone once used this line to describe the beauty of love at first sight: “Every encounter is a reunion after a long separation.”
It means that many people who seem to be meeting for the first time have, in fact, shared a deep connection in a previous life.
In the classical novel Dream of the Red Chamber, when Jia Baoyu first meets Lin Daiyu, he says something with a similar meaning:
“I’ve seen this young lady before.”
“Dream of the Red Chamber” is one of the most famous classical novels in China, written in the mid-Qing Dynasty.
The novel is set against the backdrop of the rise and fall of four great families: Jia, Shi, Wang, and Xue.
It centers on the tragic love story of Jia Baoyu and Lin Daiyu, depicting the lives of the upper class in ancient China, ..
.. and revealing both the truth of human nature and the tragedy of its time.
The author of “Dream of the Red Chamber” was Cao Xueqin.
He was born into a family of high-ranking officials and lived a life of wealth and privilege in his youth.
In his middle age, his family’s fortunes declined, and he lived in hardship.
His later years were even more difficult, and he often lacked adequate clothing and food.
He passed away before the age of fifty.
Therefore, many people believe that Cao Xueqin’s own life experiences can be seen in this novel.
The earliest name of “Dream of the Red Chamber” was “The Story of the Stone”.
The story begins with a stone that was left behind in the heavenly realm.
The stone wanted to come to the human world for a look, and coincidentally, an immortal also wished to experience life among mortals, ..
.. so they came to the human world together.
This immortal, called the Divine Attendant-in-Waiting, was reincarnated as a member of the Jia family—Jia Baoyu.
The stone was turned into the piece of jade that Jia Baoyu had in his mouth when he was born.
Jia Baoyu was handsome in appearance but had a most unusual personality.
He despised the hypocrisy of grown men and believed that gentle women were purer and more beautiful.
Therefore, he enjoyed spending time with the girls and young women of his family.
One day, a beautiful girl named Lin Daiyu came to the Jia family.
At first sight of her, Jia Baoyu couldn’t help saying, “I’ve seen this young lady before.”
Why did Lin Daiyu seem so familiar to him? Perhaps it was because they had met in a previous life.
In her previous life, Lin Daiyu was a celestial plant in the heavenly realm, ..
.. and the Divine Attendant-in-Waiting often watered her, granting her spiritual vitality.
Later, she was reincarnated as a human to repay the kindness of the Divine Attendant-in-Waiting who watered her.
For a long period after “Dream of the Red Chamber” was written, ..
.. only the first eighty chapters were circulated, and no one knew what the final ending was.
The “Dream of the Red Chamber” that everyone sees now has 120 chapters.
It is generally believed that the first eighty chapters were written by Cao Xueqin, ..
.. and the latter forty chapters were compiled and continued by another writer named Gao E.
Since the beginning and ending parts of the novel may not have been completed by the same person, ..
.. the “true ending” of the story has long been an intriguing topic of discussion.
Different people have different feelings when reading “Dream of the Red Chamber”.
Some see romantic love, some see the impermanence of life, and others see the cultural details of ancient China.
It can be said that if one wishes to appreciate the most classic works of Chinese literature, ..
.. “Dream of the Red Chamber” is an essential read.
If you find reading the original work too difficult, you can choose to watch the 1987 television series “Dream of the Red Chamber”.
Many consider it the television adaptation that stays closest to the original novel and best helps viewers understand it with ease.
If you are interested in “Dream of the Red Chamber”, you can start by watching this television series.
